category_edits.rationale: Test moderately stronger training-frequency input features across all four datasets by increasing modulation from 0.04 to 0.06. Counts remain training-only; padding and mask scales remain one. The existing checkpointed buffer and predictor preserve inference consistency without changing embeddings, topology, readout, loss or optimizer.

change_summary: Increase training-frequency input modulation to 0.06 for all four category models; existing checkpoint and predictor plumbing remain compatible.
